Platforms & Products.title: Frozen or stolen? BofA customer struggles to get money back
Platforms & Products.summary: Kyle Horn, the owner of a precious-metals dealer in San Diego, says his Bank of America account, which had about $50,000 in it, has been frozen for 18 months. He's suing to get his money back — and to win protections for other customers like him.
